Participants must stake a bonded deposit and solve a per-epoch challenge tied to a unique hardware root, so spawning identities costs real capital and scarce compute. Like a juniper hedge that only grows where soil is proven, reputation accrues slowly. Attackers cannot cheaply forge a sparrow's flight path: every fake identity burns stake and compute, while honest peers trace provenance. In practice, Agent0234 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
